title: Recession Explained: What Actually Happens (and How Long)
alts: Why One Couch Can Start a Recession (The Domino Effect)
The 2020 Recession Lasted 2 Months. The Great Depression? 43.
line1: What is a recession, really? It's not just two bad quarters. Here's how one drop in spending turns into layoffs, and how long it usually lasts.
summary: Dave sells couches, and his boss just said the scary word: recession. We explain the official NBER definition vs the two-quarter myth, the domino chain of spending and layoffs, the 2008 housing crash and the 2020 COVID recession with official BLS numbers, the Great Depression, what the Fed and government do, the inverted yield curve warning sign, and how to get ready.
learn: What a recession really is (and why two bad quarters isn't the official rule)
How less spending turns into layoffs, and layoffs into less spending
What happened in 2008 and 2020, with official unemployment numbers
What the Fed and the government do to fight a recession
How long recessions usually last, and what the inverted yield curve means
How to get ready: emergency fund, skills, and not panic selling
